decisions.failureInjection: deleting the project DB directory makes the refresh worker fail deterministically — REFRESH_FAILED + completed=false must surface, never a passing report
decisions.force: force=true wipes and fully reindexes BEFORE reporting; a file created after the initial index must appear in the force-refreshed counts
decisions.waitFalse: wait=false returns the pre-refresh snapshot marked started (pending); the formatter must never label it completed (or misleadingly failed)

limitations: Failure injection relies on the filesystem (deleting the DB dir); it is deterministic in this harness.
